description: The 'if' block in larger() is never closed, so the parser meets 'int main(' while larger()'s body is still open.
injected_faults: line 6: closing '}' of the if block is missing after 'result = a;' (the '}' on line 8 closes the if, not the function)
notes: Root is reported at the 'int' of 'int main' (line 10), where '}' was expected. The following function is parsed normally after the repair. Possible symptoms: main's body re-parsed, 'larger' reported undeclared at its two calls. gcc: line 10 col 1: ISO C forbids nested functions (it parses main as a nested function).
